verdict.rationale: FFmpeg's own docs show that one invocation can read an arbitrary number of inputs and route streams to multiple outputs via -map and filtergraphs. That gives a native, if indirect, way to handle several items at once. Bulk processing of many independent files is not documented as a first-party feature, and the community examples rely on user-written batch wrappers, which earn no credit. Missing for 10: a documented batch or bulk mode for processing many files independently, glob or list-based input handling, and independent corroboration of multi-item processing within a single command.
